item.title: Western officials fear Putin is preparing to escalate beyond Ukraine. Bild and The Telegraph outline possible Russian moves against NATO.
item.description: Fears are increasingly being voiced in the West that Vladimir Putin does not want peace talks and is planning another escalation, not only in Ukraine but against NATO countries as well. Sources for The New York Times say that the Russian president has set a goal for 2026 of “the collapse of NATO and the E.U. from within.” Bloomberg sources close to the Kremlin say that Putin is considering intensifying ballistic missile strikes or even, as a last resort, using tactical nuclear weapons in Ukraine. Zelensky’s office believes Moscow may be preparing a new offensive on Kyiv and Chernihiv. This week, CIA Director John Ratcliffe unexpectedly visited Moscow for the first time since the war in Ukraine began. According to one theory, his mission was to warn the Kremlin against attacking NATO countries. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said he sees signs that an escalation is being prepared, and that the next seven to eight months could be critical for the security of both Ukraine and the wider European region. Germany’s Bild and Britain’s The Telegraph described largely similar potential scenarios of overt or covert Kremlin aggression against NATO and the European Union.

item.title: Iran dismisses Trump's post of attack on key energy hub of Kharg
item.description:
By Phil Stewart and David Lawder

Aug 31 (Reuters) - U.S. President Donald Trump posted an AI-generated video clip that he said showed Iran's oil hub Kharg Island being blown to smithereens, which an Iranian official dismissed as "laughable", just hours after both nations resumed hostilities for the first time since July.

Several hours after the post, there was no evidence Kharg had been attacked.

The White House and the U.S. Defense Department did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment outside regular business hours.

item.title: Taiwan says 'unpredictable' China strengthens air and sea control nearby
item.description:
By Ben Blanchard

TAIPEI, Aug 31 (Reuters) - An increasingly unpredictable Beijing is tightening its grip on the air and sea around Taiwan, Taipei said in an annual review of the Chinese threat that also said China was learning lessons from issues faced by the United States in waging war on Iran.

China views democratically governed Taiwan as its own territory, has never renounced the use of force to bring the island under its control, and sends its military into the waters and airspace around Taiwan on an almost daily basis.

item.title: Turkey says it has Black Sea grain plan and is in contact with Russia, Ukraine
item.description:
ISTANBUL, Aug 31 (Reuters) - Turkey has prepared a plan for the safe passage of grain via the Black Sea and is in contact with both Russia and Ukraine regarding it, Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said on Monday.

Turkey has repeatedly expressed willingness to revive a U.N.-brokered deal that got grain out of Ukraine during wartime.

"We have prepared a plan and we are in contact with both sides regarding this plan," Fidan told a press conference in Istanbul. "If the necessary conditions emerge, we are working in particular to achieve another agreement similar to the grain deal."
